headline: Chelsea had 69% of the ball and 0.53 xG; Sunderland had 31% and 2.55 xG, and won 1-0 from a 36th-minute penalty.

caveats: No official player ratings: best/worst are Scout's pick. BBC 'Average rating' on the match page is a reader vote and is not used as a rating.

The 36' penalty was controversial per BBC (referee Gillett judged Colwill pulled Brobbey while both grappled). Reel does not claim it was right or wrong; it uses xG to test whether it decided the match.
Substitution minute conflict: ESPN lists Isidor on for Brobbey at 67', BBC report text says 77th minute. Not quoted.
ESPN commentary says Chelsea 'slip to fifth'; BBC says 'stayed fifth' and tables show 5th both before and after. Reel says 'fifth' only.
Chelsea 0.32 open-play xG is BBC's 0.3161 rounded; BBC set-play xG Sunderland 0.38 / Chelsea 0.21 (0.3772 / 0.2146).
Shots on target: ESPN and BBC both give SUN 2, CHE 4. Use these panel numbers only (the parsed shot map outcome labels differ slightly for Fofana 66' and Palmer 85').
Reddit was available in RSS mode only (no counts).
